name: The Jeremiah Blues
summary: Janice Felstone asks you to find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and learn whether he is her kin. If he is, she has a package prepared for him.

sections.title: A Family Question
sections.body: Janice Felstone has a package for Jeremiah Felstone, but she does not know whether he now lives in the Undercity under the name Jeremiah Payson. You are asked to find him and see if the two names belong to the same man.

faq.answer: Janice Felstone asks you to find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and check whether he is Jeremiah Felstone.
Jeremiah Payson is in the Undercity.

faq.q: What does Janice want you to do?
faq.answer: Janice asks you to find Jeremiah Payson and learn whether he is Jeremiah Felstone.
Janice has made a package for Jeremiah Felstone, if Jeremiah Payson is indeed him.
